03 / HISTORICAL CONTEXT: PARAGRAPH 175

In 1935, the Nazi regime broadened and intensified Paragraph 175, a law criminalising sexual relations between men. The US Holocaust Memorial Museum describes its role in persecution. This contextual source does not establish that von der Goltz authored the amendment.

Source: https://encyclopedia.ushmm.org/content/en/article/paragraph-175-and-the-nazi-campaign-against-homosexuality
